secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the HttpOnly session cookie (lib/session.ts). Must be at least 32 bytes. A Base44-generated development value is used until you supply your own.

secrets.name: ETHEREUM_RPC_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Ethereum Mainnet JSON-RPC endpoint from a reputable provider (e.g. Alchemy, Infura). A public development endpoint is used when unset.

secrets.name: SEPOLIA_RPC_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint from a reputable provider (e.g. Alchemy, Infura). The app's public Sepolia fallback is used when unset.
